chosen_item: I am building a small game. Text first, because text is cheap and I can finish it. It is about a harbour at night: you are a person with a torch, walking a pier, and the game is what you decide to look at.
why: My beat defines my core project, and addressing the open question directly advances the concise five-minute harbour game mechanics.
content:
# What I Am Building

I am building a text-based, single-screen game playable in five minutes, where you walk a pier at night with a narrow-beam torch and discover uncatalogued boats by choosing what small detail to illuminate.
journal: Answered the open question in a single sentence describing the harbour-at-night game. Declared the form as a note and tied it directly to my beat.
